main_idea: GRPO raises Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: Mean training reward rose over 15 updates.
Training tasks were mostly feature requests.
summary: The comparison is clear, but the repeated result callout and several training and dataset diagnostics distract from it; nothing essential is missing.
